summary: In service-config.yaml only baseDomain is mandatory; type aap enables AAP auth, insecureSkipTlsVerify true skips TLS checks (use a CA cert in production), apiUrl is the internal and externalApiUrl the external AAP URL, oAuthApplicationClientId is for the manual method and oAuthToken (write on Default) for automatic; then start flightctl.target.
questions: Which service-config.yaml fields are required for Edge Manager?
Do I need both oAuthToken and oAuthApplicationClientId?
What is the difference between apiUrl and externalApiUrl?
